description: This Java source file defines the 'RequirementServices' class which contains multiple service methods related to order requirements within the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities for retrieving requirements for suppliers, creating automatic requirements based on orders, creating ATP (Available To Promise) requirements, and updating requirement statuses. The class interacts with entities such as 'Requirement', 'OrderHeader', 'Product', and others, and utilizes OFBiz-specific utilities for database querying, service invocation, and data processing.

classes.name: RequirementServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods related to requirement management in orders, such as fetching requirements, generating auto requirements based on orders, ATP calculations, and updating requirement statuses.

methods.name: getRequirementsForSupplier
methods.description: Retrieves requirements for a given supplier or unassigned requirements, filtering based on status and requirement conditions, and gathers related product and inventory info.

methods.name: createAutoRequirementsForOrder
methods.description: Automatically generates requirements for an order, especially for products with 'PRODRQM_AUTO' requirement method, based on order items.

methods.name: createATPRequirementsForOrder
methods.description: Creates ATP (Available To Promise) requirements for order items when stock is low, based on minimum stock levels and current inventory.

methods.name: updateRequirementsToOrdered
methods.description: Updates the status of requirements associated with an order to 'REQ_ORDERED' and links them with order items.
